criteria.description: Primary mega disclosure and mobile toggle reach closed, open, navigation-open, and nested-open states via selector-driven interactions on [data-rmi-root]
Exactly one primary links tree (#rmi-primary-links / ul.ren-nav-links) serves desktop and mobile — no duplicated responsive branches
Exactly four direct children of #rmi-primary-links (> li count === 4): three ordinary ren-nav-link destinations plus one mega details/summary trigger
Exactly one visible mega chevron (.rmi-chevron); classless summary::after must be neutralized
Open panel exposes exactly 4 groups × 4 destinations = 16 .rmi-dest anchors with titles, 16 .rmi-dest-desc descriptions, and 16 square .rmi-dest-icon containers; no featured/raster media region
Mega footer (.rmi-footer) contains exactly one .rmi-footer-prompt, one .rmi-footer-link, and two .rmi-footer-action controls
Mega summary shares the centerY axis with peer primary links within 2px
Desktop panel sits under the bar (absolute); mobile panel stays in-flow; no horizontal overflow on html

At 834px (desktop shell, no hamburger): two-column groups with visible descriptions and readable destination copy; footer actions horizontal. At ≥64rem restore four-column destination groups with horizontal footer.
Mobile primary rows are full-width and start-aligned without nested-card details chrome; mega groups single column; descriptions visually hidden; footer actions stacked
Summary opens by click/Enter/Space; Escape closes and restores focus to SUMMARY

Desktop (≥48rem) pointer hover opens the mega disclosure; pointer remains open when moving from summary into the panel (stable close region); leaving the disclosure+panel hit region closes the disclosure. Hover is additive to click/Enter/Space, not a replacement.
With JavaScript disabled on mobile, the single tree, sixteen destinations, and footer remain usable via native disclosure
Visible interactive targets inside [data-rmi-root] meet 44×44 in a touch context
prefers-reduced-motion disables block-local transitions and animations on panel/chevron/dest/footer
Icons mega menu preview passes axe WCAG 2.1 A/AA
Light and dark surfaces resolve through RenDS semantic tokens
Destination and footer icons use ren-icon wrappers without inline SVG width/height attributes; destination icon containers are square
Icons suite adopts expectSingleVisibleAffordance, expectAligned, expectWidthRatio, expectNoOverflow, and inspectNativeChrome without dropping block-specific assertions

render-matrix.json declares 10+ states with selector actions (including hover for desktop-light-hover-open) and expectedMarkers for 16 dest / 16 desc / 16 icons / 4 groups / 1 chevron / 1 footer / 1 prompt link / 2 footer actions; tablet-light-open at 834px is a desktop-shell mega open without .ren-nav-toggle
Codex reviewed fresh desktop and mobile captures against the reference brief and cascade map
